name.text: CHEM_U04_L06_GP Q01 - Chemical and Nuclear Reactions

questiontext.text:
MLA Standard: MLA.CHEM.REA.03

Stimulus:

ProcessParticle-level evidenceClassification

Alpha decaynucleus emits alpha particlenuclear

Question: Which statement connects the model to the chemistry standard?

generalfeedback.text: Use the embedded reaction evidence, equation, data table, or model before choosing an answer.

answer.text: A process is nuclear when the nucleus changes.

feedback.text: Correct. For MLA.CHEM.REA.03, 'A process is nuclear when the nucleus changes.' is the strongest answer because it uses reaction evidence, equations, conservation, or stoichiometric reasoning from the stimulus or question. It matches the evidence in this item instead of relying on a vague claim.
